conclusion: No remaining concrete source blocker found in the reviewed native lifecycle, staging, output verification, or CI boundary. Runtime acceptance is required separately.
scope: Independent source and pinned dependency-contract review. This receipt does not claim an emulator run, installed product journey, physical device test or production backend deployment.

resolvedFindings.finding: Cancellation could reject after finish chose to retain the output.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Cancellation and terminal output/settlement decisions use the same lock. Reservation is retained until Transformer cancellation finishes; timeout captures the Job identity.

resolvedFindings.finding: Original-only audio loss and audio duration masking a truncated video were not covered by output verification.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Expected original audio reflects actual trim overlap; per-video duration, required audio, positive sample bytes, timeline coverage and displayed output geometry are checked. Low-rate final frame coverage is handled separately from high-rate bounds.

resolvedFindings.finding: Input decode dimensions and artwork/resource cleanup needed explicit bounds.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Video decode is capped to a 4K pixel envelope; artwork is sampled toward output canvas size and decoded one at a time; GL resources are released independently and idempotently.

resolvedFindings.finding: Media3 1.8 setFrameRate does not bound input video frame rates.
resolvedFindings.resolution: An explicit FrameDropEffect follows speed effects and precedes canvas processing; output sample count is bounded. Exact pinned source was checked instead of relying on newer API documentation.

resolvedFindings.finding: The custom shader needed direct checks for vertical coordinates and output-time layer windows.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The real instrumentation suite includes vertical source orientation, both translation directions, and timed artwork after trim/speed, in addition to matrix alpha/bias and audio waveform checks.

resolvedFindings.finding: Java source exclusions do not exclude the Kotlin Expo bridge from the isolated renderer harness.
resolvedFindings.resolution: A Sync task copies exactly the two production engine files; CI verifies those actual generated files against preflight source hashes and rejects unexpected Kotlin source copies.

resolvedFindings.finding: Provider-backed video staging needed bounded reads and cancellation outside a blocked reader.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Video-only content or readable external-storage sources are copied into a unique owned cache file using 64KiB chunks, a 512MiB ceiling, a free-space floor and nonblocking polling. An opened descriptor is registered before inspection. Audio/artwork/output remain private local files.

resolvedFindings.finding: Known-length open pipes could wait for EOF unnecessarily; ranged stream constructors could read before cancellation was registered.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The copy loop stops at declared length and rejects early EOF. AssetFileDescriptor reading constructors are bypassed; regular files use explicit seek, while nonzero streamed offsets are rejected before reading. Actual provider fixtures cover each boundary.

resolvedFindings.finding: The renderer needed the narrow surfaceless-context graphics repair without a Media3 API upgrade.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Module and harness select 1.8.1; CI inspects the actual resolved runtime graph and requires every Media3 component to match. Exact source/metadata comparison is retained in android-media3-patch-review.json.

resolvedFindings.finding: AGP 8.11 connected tests uninstall the test APKs and private data by default before run-as evidence extraction.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The connected-test invocation now sets the supported android.injected.androidTest.leaveApksInstalledAfterRun=true property. The disposable harness remains installed through evidence extraction; the owned emulator and AVD are still removed by the bounded cleanup path. This repairs evidence retention and does not establish a passing runtime test.

localChecks.shellSyntax: passed for both CI shell scripts

ciAcceptanceRequirements: Full ARM64 New Architecture QA compile with actual renderer bytecode, Expo registration, required native libraries, QA application ID and unsigned APK checks.
Standalone API35 emulator must execute every declared instrumentation method, produce decoded PCM/pixel/provider measurements, retain successful test XML and hashed movie evidence.
Actual generated renderer copies must match production source hashes before/after execution.
Both full app and harness must resolve every Media3 runtime component to 1.8.1.
limits: Source review and compilation alone cannot establish actual codec, graphics or provider behavior.

A timeout rejects the request and requests cancellation; Android OS metadata/codec and ContentProvider opening still rely on platform cancellation behavior. The single-job reservation prevents a stopped UI promise from starting another native writer before cleanup finishes.
Physical Android camera, HDR/HEIC media, interruptions, Photos/media-library export and installed-account journeys remain separate acceptance work.
The standalone provider is synthetic and non-exported; no QA or production user data or provider accounts are accessed.
The Media3 OSV receipt covers six direct-coordinate queries only, not the complete resolved dependency graph.
